relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: In two CMMs, acute and basal mechanical hyperalgesia was observed, and olcegepant alleviated mechanical hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: nitroglycerin
relationships.evidence_quote: After CMM establishment, mPFC and ACC showed a significant increase in the density of c-Fos+ cells and the percentage of c-Fos+ cells in NeuN+ cells, which were alleviated by OLC

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: In the NTG group, Sp5c showed a significant increase in the density of c-Fos+ cells and the percentage of c-Fos+ cells in NeuN+ cells, which was also alleviated by OLC

relationships.subject: levcromakalim
relationships.evidence_quote: mPFC, PVT, and Sp5c showed a significant increase of c-Fos expression between vehicle control and LEV group, and olcegepant reduced c-Fos expression (p < 0.05).

key_findings: NTG and LEV chronic migraine models show mechanical hyperalgesia and c-Fos activation in mPFC and Sp5c; ACC activated only in NTG model.
Olcegepant reduced hyperalgesia and brain c-Fos activation.
